reason: The frame sections and cargo mesh seem suited to making tracks that spread the rover wheels’ load across the drift.
expectation: I expect them to form some kind of crossing mat or track, though I don't know its exact form.

alternatives.reason: Sieving gravel might help prepare the crossing, but the frame and mesh seem more directly suited to spreading the load.

effect: The panels spread the wheel load and can hold gravel, so gathering gravel looks like the next step.
reaction: The raised edges give the panels a useful purpose beyond simply spreading the load.
reason: Sieving the firm gravel patch is the only gameplay action offered and may provide material for the panels.
expectation: I expect to collect or grade gravel suitable for the traction panels, though I don't know exactly what the sieve will produce.

effect: The sieve produced coarse gravel, which appears ready to fill the traction panels.
reaction: That result was expected and straightforward.
reason: Combining the gravel with the panels is the only gameplay action offered and should prepare them for the crossing.
expectation: I expect gravel-filled traction panels that can support the rover over the soft drift.

effect: The gravel-filled tracks completed the crossing preparation; the frames keep the stones in place as they support the wheels.
reaction: The explanation made the parts fit together satisfyingly, though the result was expected.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the traction panels was most worthwhile because their raised edges explained how they could both spread the load and hold gravel.

leastWorthwhile.text: Sieving the gravel was straightforward and offered no meaningful decision once it was the only gameplay action.

surprise.text: I hadn't anticipated that the frames would also prevent the gravel from spreading sideways.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the last two were the only gameplay actions offered and followed predictably from the panels' design.

continue.text: I would continue to find out what the protected seam contains; the crossing preparation itself was clear but offered limited decisions.
